sent: This is a normal heartbeat. [pause 0.3] The S-A node fires, the signal travels down through the A-V node, and both ventricles squeeze together. [pause 0.45] Now watch what happens in third-degree heart block. [pause 0.35] No signal gets from the atria down to the ventricles. [pause 0.35] The atria and ventricles each fire on their own clocks. [pause 0.4] A slow backup pacemaker below the block keeps the heart going, often at only 20 to 40 beats a minute. [pause 0.45] Put pacing pads on. [pause 0.35] If unstable, give atropine, but don't count on it. [pause 0.35] Pace, or start an epinephrine drip. [pause 0.5] Practice it on A-C-L-S med Sim. [pause 0.35] A-C-L-S med dot com. [pause 1.2]
